scope: Local Songwriter Hub matching evidence mapping only. No identity, ISRC-format or account validation, provider form, automatic matching, submission, acceptance or receipt. Songwriter Hub access does not establish Member status, collection entitlement or rights authority.

work in eligible catalog.next_step: Map the exact work in the relevant Songwriter catalog. Confirm the actual Songwriter Hub capability; do not infer Member status or collection authority from catalog access.

recording group/ISRC.next_step: Map the selected recording group and original recording/ISRC evidence. Inspect underlying recording details without changing identifiers or assuming a confirmed match.

identity evidence.next_step: Compare writers, recording artist, version and identifiers against the exact work and group. Use corroborating criteria; title similarity alone is insufficient.
identity evidence.basis: Public guidance requires selecting the correct work; writer/version review also preserves the existing local profile preflight.

songwriter_match_review.hub_eligibility: Confirm actual Songwriter Hub/account capability and catalog scope. Only supplied songwriter_hub_user is eligible for this local profile; Member roles are not interchangeable and account access remains unverified.
songwriter_match_review.identity_comparison: Review writers, version, artist and identifiers for the exact work and recording group. The helper does not inspect source contents or infer identity from titles.
songwriter_match_review.group_coverage: Review each selected group and its underlying recordings. Bound evidence is not a suggested or confirmed provider match.
songwriter_match_review.match_history: Preserve observed per-group pending, partial, accepted, rejected and rematched results separately. A local packet reports none of these outcomes; an approved suggestion and a visible matched recording are distinct observations.
songwriter_match_review.authority: Songwriter Hub visibility does not establish Member status, collection shares, mandate or authority. Review applicable rights, dates, territory and original disclosure before any separately authorized action.

review_basis: Songwriter Hub instructions document catalog visibility and match suggestions. Source binding, authority and writer/version review preserve local catalog safeguards; these are not provider form fields.
remaining_account_checks: Inspect the actual Songwriter Hub capability and work/group identity before a separately authorized suggestion.
Record only actual provider responses and observations; preparation grants no rights and produces no filing-ready payload or receipt.
